Evidence records the 2x formula, 16-page floor, 64-page unknown fallback, and vfs peak of 31744 bytes.
VirtIO-MMIO enumeration is split by architecture, with PCIe-only targets returning no MMIO slots.
Test-hooks image now embeds and verifies net and virtio-net cells, reducing stale evidence risk.
